GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (10 Jul 46) GB/CIS
(SCAPIN-1060)
APO 500
10 July 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Chinese National.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will immediately apprehend and deliver to the Commandant, Sugamo Prison, for incarceration, the following person, formerly Chinese puppet government official:
KIANG, Hung-chieh Minister of Communications
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will advise this headquarters when the above individual has been delivered to the authorities of Sugamo Prison. In the event the Japanese Government is unable to make delivery of this individual by 2400 hours, 1 August 1946, it will make a report in detail giving the present location of the individual and the reason for failure to arrest.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
